pages.title: Illager Loyalty
pages.text: A $(l:raidborn:utility_and_items/essences)Raidborn Essence$() grants Illager Loyalty, the first of the three alliance effects. Illagers stop treating you as prey, and it does not wear off on its own.

pages.title: Alliance Rules
pages.text: It carries 5 recruitment slots by default and it is the least forgiving of the three: directly hurting an Illager-side creature is enough to end it, no kill required.$(br2)Bad Omen suppresses it while it lasts, and Illager Loyalty comes back when Bad Omen goes.

pages.title: Village Relations
pages.text: Any Raidborn alliance effect costs you the village side of the game: Villagers will not deal with you, Iron Golems treat you as hostile, and Hero of the Village stays out of reach while it lasts.
